_comment: One entry per adoption decision so the gap report stops re-nagging. status: adopted|rejected|deferred. For 'adopted', source_content_hash records the reference capability's normalized hash at decision time, so a later upstream change to it can be surfaced as 'improved since adopted'.

entries.reason: Covered by our code-reviewer, which checks correctness, safety, maintainability, testability, project invariants, and verification evidence with less generic checklist noise.
Route to an optional production-readiness plugin after removing web-centric assumptions; the exploit-focused threat-model specialist is useful but not universal-template material.
Local TDD, testing rules, spec review, and code review divide this work more precisely; its universal per-function checklist would encourage unnecessary tests.
Route to an optional web-quality plugin; its metric-honest Lighthouse, CrUX, and DevTools audit is distinct but specialized and dependency-bearing.
Claude-only wrapper duplicates planning, TDD, phase execution, and bounded implementation while imposing fixed SPEC and task paths plus automatic per-task commits.
Thin wrapper around code-simplification; local AK guidance already requires minimal, surgical, behavior-preserving changes without another command surface.
Thin wrapper already surpassed by local planning and planner capabilities, which include invariants, risks, file scopes, and verification.
Redundant launcher for review behavior already provided by the local code-reviewer and Codex review command; it adds no independent workflow.
Hard-coded Claude persona fan-out duplicates underlying deferred launch capabilities and forces broad ceremony; a future plugin should expose one cross-runtime workflow.
Forces one SPEC shape and fixed sections; local brainstorming and planning preserve repository-specific requirements paths and right-sized ceremony.
Thin duplicate of local TDD, which already covers failing regression tests, characterization-first work, minimum implementation, and fresh verification.
Launcher-only surface tied to the deferred web-performance agent; a future optional plugin should expose one canonical cross-runtime trigger.

Adopted as the structural contract in authoring-for-agents references/skill-anatomy.md: layout, frontmatter rules, recommended body pattern, supporting-file thresholds, scripts-over-inline-code, catalog-search-before-creating. Rejected: their repo-root shared references/ convention, eval-runner and PR mechanics (repo-specific).
Persists prompt-shaped fetched content using an unstable response schema; URL-only keys, private-content persistence, and extra HEAD requests outweigh speculative savings.
Can substitute content produced for an earlier prompt; HTTP freshness validation does not prove that cached model-processed output suits the current question.
Injects a 191-line meta-skill into every session, duplicating native skill discovery while adding permanent context cost and a jq dependency.
Test fixture for session-start, not an independently invokable production capability.
Temporarily replaces working-file content and relies on Stop restoration; crashes, concurrent sessions, builds, and external editors create unacceptable data-integrity risk.
Test harness for simplify-ignore, not a production hook capability; scanner classification should not promote fixtures.
Umbrella packaging for the whole catalog is not separable; selective decisions avoid importing duplicate commands, risky hooks, and unrelated domain skills.
Repo-specific pointer to upstream CONTRIBUTING and open PRs; the durable anti-duplication principle already exists in local curation and lean-canon guidance.

User ruling 2026-08-13: not relevant for us as of today — no public-API surface where contract-evolution discipline (Hyrum's Law, additive-only changes) would pay off; skill is also mostly TS/REST tutorial boilerplate. Supersedes the 2026-07-15 deferral. Revisit if a project exposes an API with external consumers.
User does not do frontend work; browser/DevTools testing will not be used. Supersedes the earlier web-quality-plugin deferral.
Route to an optional production-readiness plugin after replacing Node, GitHub Actions, and Vercel assumptions with stack-aware quality-gate and rollback guidance.

Re-merged 2026-08-14 into the code-review skill (evidence: skill-comparisons/review-protocols/): approval philosophy, within-bucket structural lead, review-tests-first, reviewer-side dead-code rule, dependency discipline. Label set, five-axis rubric, sizing/SLA/handbook sections rejected — Critical/Important/Minor vocabulary is load-bearing in the task-engine fix loop. Supersedes the stale 2026-07-15 entry pointing at agent:agents/code-reviewer.
Covered by AK guidance on simplicity, surgical scope, convention matching, read-before-write, and verifiable behavior-preserving changes.
The root read order, project overlay, docs index, and adopt workflow already implement selective context; this long generic handbook adds no distinct repeated workflow.

Re-recorded 2026-08-14, superseding the stale 2026-07-15 'covered by our workflow' claim which held only at step-name level (evidence: skill-comparisons/debugging-loop/). Now genuinely absorbed into the rebuilt systematic-debugging skill: non-reproducible diagnostic tree + flake-class diagnosis (references/non-reproducible-bugs.md), localize-by-layer tree incl. test-is-wrong branch + git bisect run recipe (references/localization.md), instrumentation add/remove/keep rules, untrusted-error-output prompt-injection defense (Conduct section). Environmental escape hatch tightened per Opus critique: end-state UNRESOLVED FINDING after Phase 3 exhaustion, never a mitigation-as-fix exit. REJECTED per council bucket-06 round-001: safe-fallback/graceful-degradation patterns (incompatible with the root-cause gate); per-error-class triage trees mostly dropped as npm/browser-shaped common knowledge.
Route to an optional production-readiness plugin; retain deprecation gates and expand-migrate-contract after removing unsafe universal rollback assumptions.

Closes the 2026-07-15 deferral. ADR portion absorbed into domain-modeling/ADR-FORMAT.md (convention-first, never-delete/supersede, comment-the-trap-link-the-ADR); comment-hygiene portion absorbed into rules/python/coding-style.md (no commented-out code; no doable-now TODOs — lasting ones become beads); ADR read-order mount in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md. Not adopted as its own skill: comment-why-not-what already in coding-style, API-doc part covered by docstring+mypy rules and the api-and-interface-design rejection, README/changelog/agent-docs sections generic or already our overlay discipline.

Superseding pointer+content update of the 2026-07-15 entry (our_id command:commands/codex-critique no longer exists). The half-coverage found by execution-disciplines/ is now closed: use-codex gained the Critique discipline section — pass-the-artifact-never-your-conclusion, four-class finding classification with no silent drops, the 3-cycle bound, the doubt-theater detector. Rejected: its cross-model CLI bootstrap section (codex-adapter owns invocation).
User does not do frontend work; no frontend UI guidance will be used in this harness. Supersedes the earlier web-quality-plugin deferral.
Its autonomous commit cadence, trunk and Conventional Commit defaults, and destructive recovery guidance conflict with conservative Git authorization and safety rules.

Revisited 2026-08-12: original content restored (philosophy/anti-patterns/tone/red-flags kept) with surgical changes only — idea-doc write to docs/ideas/<name>.md is now mandatory every session, sharpening questions go inline (no AskUserQuestion popups), dead mkdir script and its Usage block removed. Coupling is strictly one-way: brainstorming routes to idea-refine and reads docs/ideas/; idea-refine never references brainstorming.

Closes the 2026-07-15 deferral. Ruled a discipline by execution-disciplines/; its durable content is now distributed: vertical slicing + tracer bullets in planning, Rules 0/0.5 scope discipline via the NOTICED BUT NOT TOUCHING format added to ak-guide section 3, don't-re-run-for-reassurance in the TDD skill, per-slice verification in execution's light path. Rejected (again): mandatory per-slice commits.

Mechanics merged into brainstorming, not installed as a skill. Taken: predict-the-next-three stop test, approval-names-the-direction gate with the four near-misses, Q/GUESS format plus its sycophancy mitigation, six-line restate with mandatory out-of-scope, live-user guard. Dropped: numeric confidence header, rationalization table, red flags (cross-cutting warnings live in .claude/rules/core/03-ak-guidelines.md).
Route to an optional production-readiness plugin; structured logs, RED metrics, traces, symptom alerts, and telemetry verification are useful but deployment-specific.

Adopted 2026-08-14 per user ruling, superseding the 2026-07-15 deferral and modifying casebook round-002's drop-the-frontend trim: spine is generic systems-engineering, Python-first (uv/py-spy/cProfile/memray/EXPLAIN ANALYZE); UI/browser content RELOCATED to references/frontend-performance.md behind an observable load condition (slow path renders in a browser), not deleted. All 8 mandated components carried at full strength: measure-first + when-NOT, symptom-to-measurement tree, identical re-measurement, noise-vs-mean, keep-or-revert table with neutral-is-a-revert, correctness-gates-the-metric, attempt ledger (durable in bead/commit, PERF.md convention replaced), CI budgets (pytest-benchmark recipe with baseline persistence, verified live). Added: counting guards over wall-clock asserts in CI. Routing boundary with systematic-debugging cut both ways: its bare 'slow' trigger narrowed to 'got-slower', two hand-off exits added (Phase 1 no-red-state, Phase 4 no-culprit bisect). Opus 5 medium critic: 15 findings (2 blocker routing leaks), all fixed. Evidence: skill-comparisons/debugging-loop/.

Whole-machine-in-one-file shape rejected; our planning skill is one organ of a five-surface machine proven in bodha-complete. Vertical-slicing articulation and dependency-graph-first absorbed into the planning rewrite; tasks/plan.md+todo.md duplicate bd; XS-XL sizing, risk-first ordering, rationalization tables rejected on record evidence.

Closes the 2026-07-15 deferral, whose 'optional production-readiness plugin' never existed (comparison: post-implementation-passes/). Adopted as the security skill: STRIDE-per-boundary threat model, three-tier system with operational Ask-First semantics, authz-vs-authn, SSRF+TOCTOU, audit triage tree, supply-chain discovery + script-blocking, rotate-don't-scrub, corrected+completed OWASP LLM Top 10 mapping. Mounted: execution routing + task packet flag + code-review lens. Rejected: the ~150 lines of Express/Node/TS example bulk; Python controls stay in rules/python/safety.md.
Route staged rollout, feature flags, monitoring, rollback triggers, and post-launch checks to an optional production-readiness plugin.
Covered by docs-researcher, which detects versions, queries current authoritative sources, forbids invented APIs, cites sources, and surfaces ambiguity.

Revisited 2026-08-12: spec half only, split from its plan/tasks/implement phases (those belong to our prepare-phases/planning/phase-execution). Taken into the spec template + brainstorming: checkable Success Criteria section name and rigor, Open Questions with a blocking-questions-block-approval rule, surface-assumptions-then-confirm practice, keep-the-spec-alive. Still rejected: the six repo-level spec areas (Tech Stack/Commands/Structure/Code Style/Boundaries — live in .claude/project/* and rules), tasks/plan.md convention (contradicts beads).

Superseding correction of the 2026-07-15 entry, whose 'covered by the local loop' claim was wrong about everything except the loop (comparison: execution-disciplines/). Now genuinely absorbed: stack-discovery-first, the Prove-It pattern, characterization path split from RED, don't-re-run-clean-suites, flakiness/isolation/snapshot warnings, rationalizations; pyramid + size model landed in rules/python/testing.md. Skill discovery and routing are already native platform and AGENTS behavior; another 191-line meta-skill would duplicate instructions and increase context pressure.

Absorbed fail-fast preflight, spec-source discovery ladder, and tooling-dedupe into the code-review skill (evidence: skill-comparisons/review-protocols/). Fowler smell catalog, three-dot merge-base, parallel sub-agents, 400-word cap rejected (snapshot model; smallest-durable rule).

Adopted verbatim (SKILL + DEEPENING + DESIGN-IT-TWICE; their agents/openai.yaml metadata excluded). Adopted as the SPINE of the rebuilt systematic-debugging skill (2026-08-14, evidence: skill-comparisons/debugging-loop/, implementing casebook bucket-06 round-001). Carried: loop-is-the-skill Phase 1 with red-capable agent-runnable exit criterion, repro-construction catalog, loop tightening, cannot-build-loop stop, minimisation with done-condition, 3-5 ranked falsifiable hypotheses with predictions, tool ladder + tagged logs, regression-test seam gate (seam criterion moved to TDD skill), cleanup + hypothesis-in-commit, secret redaction, perf branch. Opus-critic reviewed (12 findings fixed).

Copied verbatim. Composes grilling with domain-modeling so ADRs and the glossary are written during the interview rather than after.

Its one strong line — the verification cadence (typecheck regularly / focused test files regularly / full suite once at end) — was absorbed into the implementer agent, conditional on repo-provided commands (comparison: plan-execution-engines/).

Adopted verbatim per user ruling 2026-08-13 (SKILL + HTML-REPORT; agents/openai.yaml excluded), overriding the council's demote-the-CDN-report change — user will redirect the report format ad hoc if needed. Only proactive find-structural-debt capability in the harness: hot-spot scoping, deletion-test exploration, badges, ADR-conflict handling, grilling loop. Consumes codebase-design + domain-modeling + grilling.

Adopted verbatim per user ruling 2026-08-13 (SKILL + LOGIC + UI; their agents/openai.yaml metadata excluded). Both branches kept: UI.md stays behind progressive disclosure and simply won't be selected in non-UI work, so trimming it buys nothing. Fills the one mode the harness otherwise forbade: answering design questions with running throwaway code, with discipline (marked throwaway, no persistence, capture verdict then park on a throwaway branch).

Adopted-merged (comparison: execution-disciplines/): seams as pre-agreed public test boundaries — adapted from a live human gate to the plan's new 'Test seams:' field so it survives unattended runs; the tautological-test definition; implementation-coupled and horizontal-slicing anti-patterns; mock-at-system-boundaries + design-for-mockability. Rejected: refactoring-outside-the-loop (contradicts the other three and our loop).

Revisited 2026-08-12: now the SKELETON of references/spec-template.md — Problem Statement, Solution, User Stories, Implementation Decisions, Testing Decisions, Out of Scope (with our deferred|rejected tags), Further Notes — plus seam-first Testing and the prototype-snippet exception. Artifact renamed requirements doc → spec across the chain; epics carry it via --spec-id.

Copied verbatim (SKILL.md + agents/, ships user-invoked via disable-model-invocation). Adopted as-is per user decision 2026-08-12; local customization (beads-native decision tickets etc.) deferred to a later pass.
Lives in upstream's misc/ staging area, which we already ruled out of adoption scope wholesale; also refactoring-shoehorn workflow has no local use.

Seven-line alias whose entire body is 'Run a /grilling session'. Copied verbatim. Frontier rounds and non-blocking sub-agent fact-finding are genuinely absent from our grill-me, which paces at 1-3 questions and answers facts inline. Kept as a separate skill rather than merged so both pacing models stay available.

Per-unit boundary questions now live in the spec template's Implementation Decisions section (template renamed requirements-template.md → spec-template.md; output renamed to spec at docs/specs/). Everything else unchanged from the 2026-08-11 ruling: approval gate, decompose-first, four-check self-review taken; visual companion server, unprompted commit, writing-plans terminal state dropped.

GitHub reply mechanics and YAGNI grep-check rejected; cap adjudication stays owned by task-engine.

Adopted-absorbed into the rebuilt systematic-debugging skill (2026-08-14, evidence: skill-comparisons/debugging-loop/, per casebook bucket-06 round-001 absorb list). Carried: pressure armor (rationalization table merged with AER rows, red flags, ESPECIALLY-when framing, honesty rule as table row), fix counter + 3-failed-fixes architecture escalation with human gate and per-attempt written ledger line, per-boundary instrumentation as a hard multi-component conditional in Phase 3, technique assets rehomed Python-first: backward tracing + defense-in-depth (references/post-fix-hardening.md, os.environ example fixed to injected settings), condition-based waiting (typed Python wait_for), find-polluter.sh ported (runner-parameterized, pre-existing-pollution guard now exits 2 - upstream false-negative bug fixed, functionally tested). NOTE: our prior Codex falsifier is retired (user ruling 2026-08-14 - Codex quota); escalation now spawns a fresh-context Opus-class critic subagent.

Adopted-merged into the rewritten TDD skill (comparison: execution-disciplines/): writing-good-tests content — name-the-break gate, mirror-assertion/change-detector bans, mock-at-right-level rules with the boundary-contract exception, complete mock structures, test-only-methods-out-of-production, the mutation check, warning signs. Rejected: universal application + Iron Law delete-your-code enforcement (incompatible with risk-scaled routing), hard-coded npm test commands.

Rebuilt ours 2026-08-14 with its armor (evidence: skill-comparisons/review-protocols/): iron law, gate function, claim-to-evidence table, red-green proof, red flags, rationalizations, paraphrase closure — anchored to verification.md/invariants.md and the git status gate step.

Adopted-merged into the rewritten planning skill (Elaborate mode): file-map-before-tasks, Interfaces Consumes/Produces, reviewer right-sizing test, no-placeholders list, self-review checklist. Rejected: 2-5-min steps, code blocks in steps, their plan-file conventions (record-backed reasons in scratchpad/bucket2-planning-decision.md).

Adopted as one third of authoring-for-agents: Match-the-Form-to-the-Failure table, description-never-summarizes-workflow rule, rationalization tables/red flags for discipline skills, and a slimmed proportional testing ladder (baseline + stacked-pressure + wording micro-tests).
